title: Nutella Kimchi Tartine
description: A unique French-inspired dessert combining the richness of Nutella with the spicy kick of kimchi, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: 1. Toast the baguette slice until lightly browned.
2. Spread 1 tablespoon of Nutella on the toasted baguette.
3. Top the Nutella with 1 tablespoon of crumbled grilled kimchi.
4. Garnish with a few fresh mint leaves.
5. Drizzle 1 teaspoon of honey over the top.
6. Serve immediately and enjoy the spicy-sweet combination.
